verdict.rationale: Phaser's core framework is an MIT-licensed npm package with a public GitHub repository. It installs locally via `npm install phaser`, and the docs offer CDN inclusion as just one option, so the core product runs entirely on infrastructure you control. Games built with it are not tied to a licence and can move to VS Code. However, the AI-native layer (the Game Agent behind the official MCP) is a hosted Phaser Studio service, and no npm MCP package exists. missing for 10: explicit docs on building/hosting from source, a self-hostable version of the AI Game Agent/MCP, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment
